build_loader: build a data loader for imagenet with distributed sampling and multi-crop transforms
build_dataset: build an imagenet dataset from numpy arrays or image folders with configurable transforms
build_transform: build multi-crop train or validation transforms for self-supervised image augmentation
create_ImageNetNumpyDataset: create a pytorch dataset from numpy image and label arrays with optional size limit
test_build_loader: test the data loader with imagenet dataset and distributed sampler configuration
